asset.name: InfiniteScroll
asset.description: The pagination primitive loading further results near the viewport boundary while preserving restoration, retries, an end state, and an accessible manual alternative.

requires.reason: Boundary observation is pooled rather than per-list.

rationale: The manual fallback is not optional: an infinitely scrolling list with no explicit load control is unusable by keyboard and unreachable past the first window for assistive technology.
